summary: Mixed Martial Arts Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing an exclusive 50/50 revenue share partnership with Precision Peptide Company Inc. The agreement grants MMA the right to market peptide products across its combat sports ecosystem, with no capital investment. MMA receives 50% of net revenue from MMA-sourced sales in year one, then 25% thereafter. No ownership change, tender offer, or restructuring is involved. This is an ordinary marketing partnership, not a special situation. The filing is a routine current report.
